text:
I checked each title against the rules and found the fewest paid periods that cover every (episode, follower) pair. All 30 pairs are covered, and the plan costs $75.94.

**Copper Orchard (Kestrel+, Leah).** Kestrel+ access ends on 2026-11-12. The film's window runs from 2026-11-13 through 2026-12-17. One period starting 2026-11-13 covers it, for $17.99.

**The Crooked Lantern (Lumen, Leah, 2-day window).** Episodes come out weekly from 2027-01-14 to 2027-03-11. Leah needs access between 2027-01-16 and 2027-03-11, which is more than one month, so two periods are needed:
- A period from 2027-01-16 gives access through 2027-02-15. That covers episodes 1–5.
- A period from 2027-02-16 gives access through 2027-03-15. That covers episodes 6–9, including episode 6's window of 2027-02-18 to 2027-02-20.
- Cost: 2 × $15.49 = $30.98.

**The Amber Garden (Orbit, Joel, Dana and Theo).** All 8 episodes drop on 2027-01-03. The shortest window belongs to Joel and Theo (7 days), so access is needed between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-10. One period starting 2027-01-03 covers everyone, for $10.99. Orbit's existing access ends on 2026-11-20, so there is no overlap.

**The Distant Ferry (Pebble Kids, Theo, 7-day window).** Eleven weekly episodes run from 2026-12-22 to 2027-03-02.
- A period from 2026-12-29 gives access through 2027-01-28. That covers episodes 1–6; episode 6's window is 2027-01-26 to 2027-02-02.
- A period from 2027-02-03 gives access through 2027-03-02. That covers episodes 7–11, including episode 7's window ending 2027-02-09 and episode 11's window starting 2027-03-02.
- Cost: 2 × $7.99 = $15.98.

**Northline** is not needed, so it simply turns off on 2026-11-11.
